result.one_liner: GitHub's REST and GraphQL APIs let developers manage repos, issues, PRs, actions, and more programmatically across the GitHub platform.

evidence.quote: GitHub recommends that you use a fine-grained personal access token instead of a personal access token (classic).
Some REST API endpoints for GitHub Apps and OAuth apps require you to use basic authentication to access the endpoint.
replace YOUR-TOKEN with a reference to your token using "Authorization: Bearer YOUR-TOKEN"
Authentication with username and password is not supported. If you try to authenticate with user name and password, you will receive a 4xx error.
signals: oauth true, graphql true, rest true
The GitHub MCP Server connects AI tools directly to GitHub's platform.

result.notes: Basic auth is only used for a narrow subset of GitHub App/OAuth App endpoints (client ID/secret), not general API access; primary methods are PAT (api_key) and OAuth2/GitHub Apps, with Bearer token header format for all authenticated requests. Free GitHub account suffices to create PATs and register OAuth/GitHub Apps — no paid tier required for API access itself (rate limits differ by plan but base access is free). Official GitHub MCP server exists and is actively maintained by GitHub.
